subtitle: 記錄今天一件讓你有成就感的小事
task: Write a diary entry about a small win you had today. What did you do, was it difficult, and how did you feel afterwards?
taskZh: 寫一篇日記，記錄今天一件讓你有成就感的小事：你做了什麼？過程困難嗎？完成後有什麼感覺？
focus: 用過去式寫出事情經過
寫出「之前」與「之後」的心情對比
結尾說明這件小事的意義

en: Today I finally asked a question in English class. For weeks, I had wanted to speak, but I was always too shy. My heart was beating fast when I raised my hand.

I asked my teacher about the difference between two words. My voice was a little quiet, but she understood me. She smiled and said it was a great question. Two classmates told me later that they had the same question.
It was only one question, but I felt very proud of myself. Tomorrow I want to try again. Small steps like this will help me become more confident.
zh: 今天我終於在英文課上提問了。好幾個星期以來，我一直想發言，但總是太害羞。舉手的時候，我的心跳得好快。
我問老師兩個單字有什麼不同。我的聲音有點小，但她聽懂了。她笑著說這是個好問題。後來有兩位同學告訴我，他們也有同樣的疑問。
雖然只是一個問題，但我覺得很以自己為傲。明天我想再試一次。像這樣的小小一步，會幫助我變得更有自信。

patterns.pattern: For weeks, I had wanted to …, but …
patterns.zh: 過去完成式：一直想做某事，卻……
patterns.example: For weeks, I had wanted to speak, but I was always too shy.

patterns.zh: 過去進行式＋when：描寫當下的緊張
patterns.example: My heart was beating fast when I raised my hand.

patterns.pattern: It was only …, but I felt …
patterns.example: It was only one question, but I felt very proud of myself.

patterns.zh: 說明這件事帶來的幫助
patterns.example: Small steps like this will help me become more confident.

parts: She said it was a great question.
combine.answer: She smiled and said it was a great question.

parts: My voice was a little quiet.
combine.answer: My voice was a little quiet, but she understood me.

paraphrase.sentence: I felt very proud of myself.
answers: I was really proud of what I did.
I was always too nervous to speak.
